summary: All Phase 1+ runtime work is BLOCKED. Phase 0 and Phase 0.5 (provenance) are PASS, but the SM120 expert-kernel compatibility gate has not been verified and the captured routing trace gate is still BLOCKED. Do not start Phase 1 implementation until all four gates reach PASS.

checkpoint_inventory_phase0.notes: Architecture fields (num_hidden_layers=92, num_experts=512, num_experts_per_tok=10, hidden_size=8192, moe_intermediate_size=2048) are checkpoint-derived from config_sha256 above.

routing_trace_provenance_phase0_5.notes: Synthetic trace with checkpoint-derived architecture (data_classification: synthetic_with_checkpoint_derived_arch). Gates the simulator; does NOT gate Phase 1 because a captured trace is still needed for realistic stalling-miss measurements.
routing_trace_provenance_phase0_5.blocking_finding: Captured-on-real-requests trace is still missing. Until then, any Phase 1 capacity plan is an estimate, not a measurement.

dense_execution_format_chosen.notes: INT4/NF4 mandatory. The 88.03 GiB FP16/BF16 dense footprint cannot fit on 32GB VRAM.

sm120_expert_kernel_compatibility.notes: vllm_moet_sm120_kernels.status is still requires_verification. The kernel-compatibility artifact now uses a per-operator evidence schema (16 operators: full_attention_*, linear_attention_*, routed_expert_grouped_gemm, shared_expert_dense_gemm, router_topk, mtp_*, embedding, lm_head). Actual Qwen3.8 safetensors naming is 'mlp.experts.gate_up_proj' (fused) and 'mlp.experts.down_proj' (not w1/w2/w3). Each operator must move off BLOCKED with non-null evidence_log + upstream_commit before Phase 1 can start.
sm120_expert_kernel_compatibility.blocking_finding: Do not start Phase 1 expert-kernel integration until this gate moves to PASS. See artifacts/kernel-compatibility.json go_no_go_gate_requirements for the checklist.
